desc:
🚆 Welcome to Railworks! 🚆

Drive, customize, and crash trains across a huge brick-built railway! Explore the world, complete missions, and unlock new trains.

⚙️ Realistic train physics
💥 Dynamic crashes and derailments
🛤️ Explore stations, junctions, and countryside
🚦 Follow signals and speed limits
🎨 Customize trains with carriages and paint
🏆 Complete career missions to earn points and unlock new trains
🚂 Choose from a variety of locomotives and trains

Whether you enjoy realistic driving or chaotic train crashes, there's something for everyone!

All aboard! 🚆✨
